name: claude-mods
description: Claude Code mods: a session ledger and a side chat.

plugins.name: ledger
plugins.description: A running record of each Claude Code session: topics, decisions in your own words, open questions with a recommended answer, to-dos for you and for Claude. Shown in a panel; /ledger opens it.

plugins.name: sidechat
plugins.description: Ask about your session in a side panel without touching the main conversation: recap, what is it doing now, explain copied text, follow-ups, diagrams, and a note back to main. /sidechat opens it.
